(define (len [text : (& text str)]) : i64
  (__tl_string_length text))

(define (main) : i64
  (let
    [text : String "move"]
    [borrowed : (& text str) (& text)]
    (begin
      (let
        [moved : String text]
        (__tl_string_length moved))
      (__tl_string_length borrowed))))
